elements.name: Cancel closing the application when a document has unsaved changes

steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates a sketch on a datum plane without saving the document
the user selects the application window's Close control
a save-changes prompt identifies the part document
the prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel
the user chooses Cancel
the save-changes prompt closes
the part document remains open
the MCAD Software remains open

elements.name: Cancel closing the application when an assembly has unsaved changes

steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-assembly.oad` is open in the MCAD Software
the user inserts `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` as an occurrence without saving the assembly
the user presses Alt+F4
a save-changes prompt identifies the assembly document
the prompt offers Yes, No and Cancel
the prompt shows the "Always show this message" setting
the user presses Escape
the save-changes prompt closes
the assembly document remains open
the MCAD Software remains open

elements.name: Close the application when the open document has no unsaved changes

steps.name: the saved assembly fixture "fixtures/cad/blank-metric-assembly.oad" is the only open model document and is unchanged in the MCAD Software
the user selects the application window's Close control
the MCAD Software closes without a save-changes prompt

elements.name: Close the application when no document is open

steps.name: Home is the only open document tab with no model, drawing, or presentation document open in the MCAD Software
the user selects the application window's Close control
the MCAD Software closes without a save-changes prompt
